text:
alex_m: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — token validation outage. I put together the action list we discussed. Main issues: rotation lag on service keys + two missing audit events. Need clear owners and dates. @maria_g @dinesh_k please claim items.

maria_g: I can take secrets rotation owner. Will set milestone: rotation automation by 2026-04-15. I'll create a PR for the periodic job and add tests.

dinesh_k: I'll own token validation hotfix + tests. Plan: fix + unit tests by end of week, canary deploy Mon -> prod Tue (pending CI).

jess_r: I'll handle the audit-logging gap and build the dashboard. ETA 2026-04-20. Will add log-retention and links to the runbook.

alex_m: Thanks. Also want a follow-up on recurring patterns — looks like rotation lag repeats ~90 days. @security_ops any recommendations for alerting thresholds?

security_ops: Agreed. We'll add a metric token_age_seconds and alert when > 0.8 * TTL. Also adding a scheduled check at 30/60/90 days to surface regressions. Filing as recurrence_alert.

incident-bot: Reminder: Action 'secrets_rotation' assigned to maria_g, due 2026-04-15. Link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/token-rotation>

maria_g: Draft cron for rotation automation (posting here for visibility):
```yaml
# rotation job config
schedule: "0 3 * * 1"
action: rotate-secrets
verify: run-integration-tests
notify: #security_ops
```

dinesh_k: For validation tests, add this healthcheck to CI: `curl -fS http://localhost:8080/health/token-validation` -> exit 0. Also adding unit tests for expiry edgecases.

alex_m: Summary + owners (I'll update the postmortem doc):
- secrets_rotation: maria_g -> 2026-04-15
- token_validation_fix: dinesh_k -> 2026-03-31
- audit_logging_dashboard: jess_r -> 2026-04-20
- recurrence_alert: security_ops -> 2026-04-10

jess_r: I need write access to infra/logging to push the dashboard branch. Who can grant?

alex_m: @ops_oncall can you grant jess_r write on infra/logging?

ops_oncall: granted jess_r write on repo infra/logging.

maria_g: I'll post weekly check-ins in #incidents until all actions are closed.

dinesh_k: Opening the PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/token-service/pull/429 (contains hotfix + tests).

alex_m: Nice. We'll have a short sync 2026-04-05 10:00 PT to review progress. Please update the tracker before then.

jess_r: Added dashboard skeleton and sample queries to the branch, pinging once access confirmed.

alex_m: Final note — let's make sure runbook has a precise post-rotation verification checklist (success criteria + smoke tests). If anyone wants to add items, append to the runbook link above.

maria_g: Will add verification steps and a rollback procedure.

incident-bot: Action 'token_validation_fix' moved to In Progress (owner: dinesh_k).

alex_m: Great work team. We'll close this thread after the tracker shows all items done. :thumbsup:
